description.en: Mr Tyson's bank barn in the field, built into the hill: the village's stores upstairs, sacks of oats, the byre below with the cows, a calf in the straw and Jack's sheep fed in winter, warm and dry in its shelter, and the mice the owl comes for.
description.sl: Skedenj v bregu gospoda Tysona na polju, vkopan v hrib: vaške zaloge zgoraj, vreče ovsa, spodaj hlev s kravami, tele na slami in Jackove ovce, ki jih pozimi krmijo, na toplem in suhem v zavetju, in miši, po katere pride sova.
description.it: Il fienile nel pendio del signor Tyson nel campo, costruito dentro la collina: le scorte del paese al piano di sopra, i sacchi di avena, sotto la stalla con le mucche, un vitello sulla paglia e le pecore di Jack nutrite d'inverno, al caldo e all'asciutto al riparo, e i topi per cui viene il gufo.
description.de: Herrn Tysons Hangscheune auf dem Feld, in den Hügel gebaut: oben die Vorräte des Dorfes, Säcke voll Hafer, unten der Kuhstall mit den Kühen, ein Kalb im Stroh und Jacks Schafe, im Winter gefüttert, warm und trocken im Unterschlupf, und die Mäuse, wegen denen die Eule kommt.

words.example_en: The bank barn is built into the hill.
words.example_sl: Skedenj v bregu je vkopan v hrib.
words.example_it: Il fienile nel pendio è costruito dentro la collina.
words.example_de: Die Hangscheune ist in den Hügel gebaut.
words.note: A bank barn is built into a bank (a slope): the carts go in at the top by a ramp, the animals live downstairs.
words.note_sl: Bank barn je skedenj, vkopan v breg (bank): vozovi zapeljejo noter zgoraj po klancu, živali živijo spodaj.
words.note_it: Un bank barn è costruito in un pendio (bank): i carri entrano in alto da una rampa, gli animali stanno di sotto.
words.note_de: Eine bank barn ist in einen Hang (bank) gebaut: die Wagen fahren oben über eine Rampe hinein, die Tiere wohnen unten.

words.example_en: The cows are warm in the byre.
words.example_sl: Krave so v hlevu na toplem.
words.example_it: Le mucche stanno al caldo nella stalla.
words.example_de: Die Kühe haben es warm im Kuhstall.
words.note: Byre is the northern word for a cowshed. In Cumbria you hear shippon too.
words.note_sl: Byre je severnjaška beseda za hlev. V Cumbrii slišiš tudi shippon.
words.note_it: Byre è la parola del nord per la stalla. In Cumbria si sente anche shippon.
words.note_de: Byre ist das nordenglische Wort für den Kuhstall. In Cumbria hört man auch shippon.

words.example_en: The village keeps its stores upstairs.
words.example_it: Il paese tiene le scorte al piano di sopra.
words.example_de: Das Dorf lagert seine Vorräte oben.
words.note: Stores: food and things kept for later, for the winter. (In America a store is a shop.)
words.note_sl: Stores: hrana in stvari, shranjene za pozneje, za zimo. (V Ameriki je store trgovina.)
words.note_it: Stores: cibo e cose messe da parte per dopo, per l'inverno. (In America uno store è un negozio.)
words.note_de: Stores: Essen und Dinge, aufgehoben für später, für den Winter. (In Amerika ist ein store ein Laden.)

words.example_en: The calf is sleeping in the straw.
words.note: One calf, two calves (like half, halves). The l is silent: calf rhymes with half.
words.note_sl: Eno tele, dve: calves (kot half, halves). L se ne izgovori: calf se rima s half.
words.note_it: Un vitello, due calves (come half, halves). La l non si pronuncia: calf fa rima con half.
words.note_de: Ein Kalb, zwei calves (wie half, halves). Das l ist stumm: calf reimt sich auf half.

words.note: A sack is a big bag of cloth: a sack of oats, a sack of potatoes. Get the sack: lose your job!
words.note_sl: Sack je velika vreča iz blaga: a sack of oats, a sack of potatoes. Get the sack: dobiti odpoved!
words.note_it: Un sack è un grande sacco di tela: a sack of oats, a sack of potatoes. Get the sack: essere licenziati!
words.note_de: Ein sack ist ein großer Sack aus Stoff: a sack of oats, a sack of potatoes. Get the sack: gefeuert werden!

words.example_en: There are mice in the barn.
words.example_it: Nel fienile ci sono i topi.
words.example_de: In der Scheune gibt es Mäuse.
words.note: One mouse, two mice. Old barns here have an owl hole high in the wall: the barn owl comes in for the mice.
words.note_sl: Ena miš, dve: mice. Stari skednji tu imajo visoko v steni luknjo za sovo: pegasta sova pride po miši.
words.note_it: Un topo, due mice. I vecchi fienili qui hanno in alto nel muro un buco per il barbagianni, che entra a caccia di topi.
words.note_de: Eine Maus, zwei mice. Alte Scheunen hier haben oben in der Wand ein Eulenloch: die Schleiereule kommt wegen der Mäuse.

words.example_en: In winter the sheep eat hay.
words.example_it: D'inverno le pecore mangiano il fieno.
words.example_de: Im Winter fressen die Schafe Heu.
words.note: In winter, in summer: in with the seasons. The winter months: December, January, February.
words.note_sl: In winter, in summer: z letnimi časi in. Zimski meseci: December, January, February.
words.note_it: In winter, in summer: con le stagioni si usa in. I mesi d'inverno: December, January, February.
words.note_de: In winter, in summer: bei Jahreszeiten in. Die Wintermonate: December, January, February.

words.example_en: Jack feeds his sheep in the morning.
words.example_it: Jack dà da mangiare alle pecore la mattina.
words.note: Feed, fed, fed. You feed the animals: they eat.
words.note_sl: Feed, fed, fed. You feed the animals: ti krmiš živali, one jedo.
words.note_it: Feed, fed, fed. You feed the animals: tu dai da mangiare agli animali, loro mangiano.
words.note_de: Feed, fed, fed. You feed the animals: du fütterst die Tiere, sie fressen.

words.note: Oats are a grain, always plural: oats are good for porridge.
words.note_sl: Oats je žito, vedno v množini: oats are good for porridge (za ovseno kašo).
words.note_it: Oats è un cereale, sempre al plurale: oats are good for porridge (per il porridge).
words.note_de: Oats ist ein Getreide, immer im Plural: oats are good for porridge (für Haferbrei).

words.example_en: The barn gives the sheep shelter from the rain.
words.example_sl: Skedenj ovcam daje zavetje pred dežjem.
words.example_it: Il fienile dà riparo alle pecore dalla pioggia.
words.example_de: Die Scheune gibt den Schafen Schutz vor dem Regen.
words.note: Shelter from the rain, the wind, the snow: a place where you are safe and dry.
words.note_sl: Shelter from the rain, the wind, the snow: zavetje pred dežjem, vetrom, snegom, kjer si na varnem in suhem.
words.note_it: Shelter from the rain, the wind, the snow: un riparo dalla pioggia, dal vento, dalla neve, dove sei al sicuro e all'asciutto.
words.note_de: Shelter from the rain, the wind, the snow: ein Schutz vor Regen, Wind und Schnee, wo man sicher und trocken ist.

words.note: Straw is dry and yellow, for the animals to lie on. Hay is grass, for them to eat.
words.note_sl: Straw je suha rumena slama, da živali ležijo na njej. Hay je seno, da ga jedo.
words.note_it: Straw è la paglia, secca e gialla, per far sdraiare gli animali. Hay è il fieno, da mangiare.
words.note_de: Straw ist Stroh, trocken und gelb, zum Liegen für die Tiere. Hay ist Heu, zum Fressen.

words.example_en: An owl lives in the old barn.
words.example_it: Nel vecchio fienile vive un gufo.
words.example_de: In der alten Scheune wohnt eine Eule.
words.note: Owl rhymes with towel. The barn owl is white and flies at night, without a sound.
words.note_sl: Owl se rima s towel. Pegasta sova (barn owl) je bela in leti ponoči, brez glasu.
words.note_it: Owl fa rima con towel. Il barbagianni (barn owl) è bianco e vola di notte, senza un rumore.
words.note_de: Owl reimt sich auf towel. Die Schleiereule (barn owl) ist weiß und fliegt nachts, ohne einen Laut.
